tdd_result.description: Implement failure and timeout semantics ticket

data.commit: b224c00 (ticket branch only; integration branch untouched)
delivered: Backend failure semantics now distinguishes explicit rejection from timeout/unobservable outcomes at every stage; submit timeout is worded as '投递结果未确认，不能据此断定未发送' and never claims success.
Failure results retain only acquired tabId/paneId/agentName; unacquired identifiers are omitted. Workspace/tab/start failures append stage-specific site information.
Frontend failure panel gives stage-specific site/uncertainty wording instead of a generic 'unconfirmed' line for explicit rejections.
Herdr fixture records unsupported commands so external records prove no extra create/retry/close/delete actions.
Added failure matrix coverage for unreachable Herdr, zero/multi Workspace matches, workspace-query failure, tab-create failure, agent-start failure, prompt rejection, and prompt timeout.

criteria_evidence.criterion: Herdr unreachable, zero-match, multi-match fail through the public creation entry; no Tab/Workspace creation, no auto-start/fallback
criteria_evidence.evidence: backend/tests/bot_creation.rs: an_unreachable_herdr_fails_before_any_tab_or_agent_control; workspace_mismatches_fail_without_creating_a_tab (exact call sequence [workspace_list], empty tabs; herdr-unavailable / workspace-not-found / workspace-ambiguous)

criteria_evidence.criterion: Fault injection after Tab creation, after agent readiness, and submission timeout; public result shows stage, known site, and acquired identifiers without fabricating missing ones
criteria_evidence.evidence: a_failed_agent_start_never_submits_input (tab/pane/agentName retained, no prompt); a_rejected_submission_fails_creation_and_keeps_the_created_objects; a_timed_out_submission_is_unconfirmed_and_keeps_the_site_without_retrying; workspace_query_and_tab_failures_stop_the_creation_chain asserts tabId/paneId/agentName absent on pre-Tab failures

criteria_evidence.criterion: Errors/timeouts stop later stages; external fixture records prove created objects remain and no close/delete/retry occurs
criteria_evidence.evidence: Exact call sequences and tabs.jsonl assertions in the matrix tests; fixture usage() now records unsupported commands; 300-500ms post-failure rechecks show unchanged calls and tabs

criteria_evidence.criterion: After external side effects, failure/uncertain responses cause no extra creation, duplicate delivery, deletion, or close
criteria_evidence.evidence: Prompt rejection and timeout tests assert exactly one tab_create, one agent_start, one agent_prompt, one retained tab, and no unsupported commands

criteria_evidence.criterion: Explicit rejection says the site exists and submission failed; timeout says result unconfirmed, not definitely unsent, and not successful
criteria_evidence.evidence: Backend stage_message branches; frontend failureOutcomeText; frontend/tests/botCreation.test.tsx rejection and timeout tests; browser rejection test

criteria_evidence.criterion: Workspace query, Tab creation, start/readiness, and submit stages show interruption semantics without hidden retry/fixed-delay readiness/failure continuation
criteria_evidence.evidence: workspace_query_and_tab_failures_stop_the_creation_chain; start/submit failure and timeout tests; existing stage_progress_waits_for_readiness_and_does_not_wait_for_the_model_turn
